'''Level 35''' was a level of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] on which the [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] [[Dark Melody]] was located<ref name="TF" /> during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mander Zuma]] and his associates [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]] traveled to Level 35 to visit the Dark Melody while investigating the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Tempest (spice)|tempest]].<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Meldark]], a patron of the Dark Melody, claimed to be the best [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] on the 35th level.<ref name="TF" />
